styles.site_slang: the way crew members talk on site: slang, abbreviations and short sentences
styles.typos: with realistic typos and missing letters in the same language as the original (English), as a foreman types fast on a phone
styles.mixed_language: mixing German and English in the same message, as a bilingual foreman writes it
styles.asr: as a speech-to-text transcript: no punctuation at all, all lowercase, as the transcription would deliver it
styles.long: as a long message with small talk around the fact: greetings, the weather, thanks, the weekend

rev_c.site_slang: Got A-201 Rev C attached. In 3B, the partition between bedroom and living room moves 300 mm north. Rev C replaces Rev B.
rev_c.typos: Attached A-201 Rev C. The partiton between bedroom and living room in 3B shifts 300 mm north. Rev C replaces Rev B.
rev_c.mixed_language: Anbei A-201 Rev C. Die Trennwand zwischen Schlafzimmer und Wohnzimmer in 3B verschiebt sich 300 mm nach Norden. Rev C ersetzt Rev B.
rev_c.long: Hey there, hope you're doing well! The weather's been pretty nice around here lately, so I can't complain. Anyway, thanks for your patience on this one — I've attached A-201 Rev C for you. Just so it's clear, the partition between bedroom and living room in 3B shifts 300 mm north. Also, Rev C replaces Rev B. Hope you have a great weekend!

Anyway, just wanted to give you a quick heads-up — we're starting the 3B partitions tomorrow at seven, per A-201 rev B. Thanks for staying on top of things, and hope you have a great weekend!

trucks_4.site_slang: Confirming Friday's podium topping pour. Sending 4 trucks not 3, mix volume got revised. First truck on site 7:00.

trucks_4.long: Hey there, hope you're doing well! The weather's been pretty decent around here lately, hasn't it? Anyway, I just wanted to reach out and confirm Friday's podium topping pour. Quick update on that: we are sending 4 trucks instead of 3, since the mix volume was revised. Also, the first truck will be on site 7:00. Thanks so much for your help with all of this, and I hope you have a great weekend!

insp_moved_2a.site_slang: Unit 2A rough plumbing inspection, Thursday's off, now Friday 14:00.

Thanks for your patience while we sorted this out. So, Unit 2A rough plumbing inspection moved from Thursday to Friday 14:00. Hope that works for everyone, and enjoy your weekend!
